en.summary: Safer backups, easier marks entry on phones, and clearer reports.
items: A smarter backup reminder based on how much has changed, and a Check a backup file option that compares a saved file with your records without changing anything.
Saving as you type is faster and more dependable, and your work is saved when you leave the page.
Header, tables and previews fit phones, tablets and large screens better; buttons are easier to tap.
Optional one-subject marks entry in both marks editors.
Class Results and the Cumulative Class Report use the page width more sensibly, with long names wrapping instead of being cut off.

sw.summary: Nakala rudufu salama zaidi, kuingiza alama kwenye simu kwa urahisi, na ripoti zilizo wazi zaidi.
items: Kikumbusho cha nakala rudufu kinachozingatia kiasi kilichobadilika, na chaguo la Kagua faili ya nakala rudufu linalolinganisha faili iliyohifadhiwa na rekodi zako bila kubadilisha chochote.
Kuhifadhi unapoandika ni haraka na kutegemewa zaidi, na kazi yako huhifadhiwa unapoondoka kwenye ukurasa.
Kichwa, majedwali na hakikisho vinatoshea vizuri zaidi kwenye simu, tablet na skrini kubwa; vitufe ni rahisi kubonyeza.
Kuingiza alama za somo moja kwa hiari katika vihariri vyote viwili vya alama.
Matokeo ya Darasa na Ripoti Limbikizi ya Darasa zinatumia upana wa ukurasa vizuri zaidi, majina marefu yakivunjwa badala ya kukatwa.
